observations: Photo 0: A wooden pallet on a concrete floor; light-colored timber slats with multiple stringers underneath; no visible brand markings.
Photo 1: Another angle of the same pallet; top deck slats visible; some knots/holes in wood; still no visible pallet stamp/grade.
Photo 2: Stacked pallets in a warehouse; shows the pallet construction and that multiple pallets are available; no readable stamp/size markings.

claims.claim: Wooden pallets are the backbone of supply chain logistics, manufacturing, and warehousing, while...
claims.evidence: Seller text is generic and does not describe the specific pallet’s condition, size, or quantity.

risks.risk: Pallet size/standard (e.g., 4-way vs 2-way, and dimensions) is not shown clearly, which affects buyer use and pricing.
risks.proof: A photo with a tape measure showing length x width x height, plus a shot of the underside showing how many entry ways (fork access) it has.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic wooden pallet with unknown dimensions/entry type.

risks.risk: Condition (cracks, broken boards, loose nails, infestation/rot) cannot be confirmed from these angles.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all corners and underside stringers, and one photo showing any broken/soft boards.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used/possibly imperfect condition (not “as new”).

risks.risk: Treatment status (heat-treated vs chemically treated) and any stamp are not readable; this matters for food/export and compliance.
risks.proof: A clear close-up of any stamp/mark on the pallet (e.g., IPPC/HT/MB) on at least two sides.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as untreated/unknown treatment (worst case for compliance).

risks.risk: Quantity being sold is unclear (single pallet vs multiple).
risks.proof: A photo showing the total count (or a clear statement of quantity) and/or a shot of pallets arranged in a known number.

proof_requests: Confirm quantity (how many pallets) and whether they are all the same size/condition.
Provide pallet dimensions (length x width x height) with a tape measure.
Send close-ups of all four corners and the underside stringers (look for cracks/rot/loose boards).
response.reason: From the photos, it’s a wooden pallet, but key pricing drivers are missing: exact size/entry type, condition details, treatment stamp, and quantity. Without these, a worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
